PistolAmmo:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production diffuse UV texture atlas for a low-poly PlayStation 1 survival-horror game pickup.
Create ONE flat texture atlas for 9mm Luger pistol ammunition. Landscape image exactly 3:2 overall aspect ratio, requested 1536 by 1024 pixels. The canvas is an EXACT regular grid of THREE columns and TWO rows of equal square panels, panel boundaries at one-third/two-thirds of width and halfway height. Each panel fills its entire square edge-to-edge; no gaps, gutters, labels naming the views, cutting guides, perspective, rendered boxes, shadows, backgrounds or objects outside panels.
Panel order top row: FRONT, BACK, LEFT END. Bottom row: RIGHT END, TOP LID, BOTTOM. This order describes layout only, do not write those view names. All panels are aligned upright for direct UV mapping.
Design: dull burgundy-red and warm off-white cardboard, black ink. Authentic mid/late-20th-century commercial ammunition packaging layout informed by real packaging proportions, original generic graphic design without real or invented manufacturer brand names/logos. All six faces must look like the same carton: large legible caliber on front and both ends and lid, matching wraparound stripes at consistent panel heights. Flat printed cardboard, restrained frayed edges, faded ink, corner rubs, grime, paper grain, creases, slight moisture spotting. Keep readability strong and typography well inside panel edges. Retro bitmap typography, deliberate blocky pixel texture detail; approximately 128x128 effective texels per panel, limited dusty palette, no glossy photo finish, no blood, no emissive areas.
Front exact large text "9 mm LUGER" and smaller "PISTOL CARTRIDGES". Include small straight-sided brass cases with round-nosed copper-jacketed bullets, a simple accurate printed side-view cartridge illustration as printed graphic on front. Back use same caliber title with small understated generic block print and batch mark "LOT 84B"; no detailed safety instructions or readable technical loading data. Left and right end use just large caliber "9 mm LUGER", matching colors and broad stripe. Top lid prominent "9 mm LUGER" with small "PISTOL CARTRIDGES". Bottom weathered uncoated tan cardboard with glued seam and small lot marking. No package quantity claims or prices. The six square panels are material texture images, not a sheet of photographed 3D packages.
